title: The marketing footer links the brand profiles
detail:
The footer carries no social links today. Render SOCIAL_PROFILES with kit components and tokens; no new styles. Context: docs/marketing/off-site-seo-worksheet.md.

Shipped for the profiles that exist (Instagram, TikTok): both public footers (MarketingFooter and SiteFooter) render SOCIAL_PROFILES through socialLabel, beside Contact in each legal row, existing classes only. LinkedIn, YouTube and Facebook appear automatically once LIVE-1134 adds them.
